_note: Cost model used to put RL and LLM runs on one dollar axis. GPU and CPU rates are assumptions (placeholder) until a dated quote is pinned; API prices are the listed prices recorded at launch of each LLM study.

gpu.name: AMD MI350X (eg15 node, 8 GPUs), one training run per GPU
gpu.basis: GPU-hours = wall-clock hours of the run (elapsed_seconds of the last checkpoint in curve.json). Runs that shared a GPU are counted as one full GPU, so costs are upper bounds.

cpu.name: x86 server core (tModLoader headless, one process per core)

rl_inference._note: Policy inference per 3,000-step episode: 3,000 forward passes of a 0.47M-parameter network. Not measured; an order-of-magnitude estimate.
